notes: SR98 La Redoute Interieurs FR (laredoute.fr). Same access pattern as bs98/cl98 (Cloudflare Country-challenge 403 on /pplp/ via curl, Playwright, and WebFetch; Claude-in-Chrome bypassed it and was used for all PLP checks). NAVIGATION: the brand page /la-redoute-interieurs.aspx has its own 'Nouveautes' nav link, but it is a template/data bug - it points to /pplp/85201/98907/cat-275047.aspx, which is actually 'Nouveautes AM.PM' (a sibling in-house brand's New Arrivals node, confirmed via page title and an all-AM.PM brand DOM scan, count 566); appending brndid=la-redoute-interieurs to that URL made no difference (title/count unchanged), confirming the filter is silently ignored on that node - same 'ignored brndid' pattern documented in the prior Home-Decor pass for unrelated nodes. Main mega-menu 'Decoration' flyout and the general nav have no direct 'Nouveautes' entry. Found the real one indirectly: the 'Bons plans' > Outlet tab > 'La Redoute Interieurs' promo hub (/pplp/cat-356660.aspx, 'Collection La Redoute Interieurs' - see cl98 notes, this hub itself is a French Days seasonal showcase, not used as a row here) contains a 'Les nouveautes' carousel section with its own 'Voir tout' link to /pplp/cat-389892.aspx. Opened that URL directly: title 'Les nouveautes Collection La Redoute Interieurs | La Redoute', heading count 448, footer pagination 'Page 1 sur 5' (a genuine flat, paginated PLP, unlike the non-paginated cat-356660 hub it was linked from). Verified brand purity via a DOM scan of the all-caps brand-name spans on the page - only 'LA REDOUTE INTERIEURS' appears, no other brands, so no brndid param is needed (the URL is already brand-scoped). This reads as a genuine 'recently added to the catalogue' listing (not a lookbook/campaign page - it has the same flat grid/pagination/product-card structure as every other verified category PLP), so it qualifies as New Arrivals per the brief. Checked robots.txt, footer, homepage nav DOM regex-scanned for New Arrivals-type anchor text, and site search (unreliable/non-discriminating here, treated as supporting evidence only) - no second/alternate New Arrivals listing was found for this brand beyond cat-389892.

rows.evidence: Page heading 'Les nouveautes Collection La Redoute Interieurs' / 'Les nouveautes' followed by count '448'; pagination footer reads 'Page 1 sur 5'; page title tag is 'Les nouveautes Collection La Redoute Interieurs | La Redoute'
